# WheelHouse IT

> > A 5-star managed services provider (MSP) delivering comprehensive IT solutions, security, and compliance expertise across South Florida, New York, Los Angeles, and internationally.

WheelHouse IT is an established MSP with 20+ years of experience serving regulated industries including healthcare, finance, accounting, insurance, and manufacturing. The company holds SOC 2 compliance, is a Microsoft Partner, and operates 24/7/365 support across multiple locations with a team of 50+ staff members.

## Key Topics

- Managed IT Services
- Managed Security Services
- SOC 2 Compliance
- HIPAA Compliance
- Microsoft 365
- Cloud Services
- Mobile Device Management
- Cybersecurity Monitoring
- Help Desk Support
- Co-Managed IT
- Business Continuity
- Network Infrastructure
- Disaster Recovery
- Multi-Location Support
- Regulated Industry Expertise

## Core Services

- [Managed IT Services](https://www.wheelhouseit.com/managed-it-services): Comprehensive managed IT services including SOC 2 compliance, Microsoft 365 management, and disaster recovery for growing businesses
- [Co-Managed IT Services](https://www.wheelhouseit.com/co-managed-it-services): Hybrid IT support combining internal teams with WheelHouse expertise for Microsoft 365 and security services
- [IT Support](https://www.wheelhouseit.com/it-support): Professional IT support and helpdesk services compliant with HIPAA, SOC 2, and PCI DSS for regulated businesses nationwide
- [Managed Security Services](https://www.wheelhouseit.com/managed-security): 24/7/365 managed security with SOC, SIEM, dark web monitoring, MFA, and intrusion detection
- [Cloud Managed Services](https://www.wheelhouseit.com/cloud-managed-services): Public, private, and hybrid cloud solutions with SLA guarantees and expert management

## Infrastructure & Network Solutions

- [Mobile Device Management](https://www.wheelhouseit.com/mobile-device-management): MDM solutions using Microsoft Intune for comprehensive device security and data backup
- [Structured Cabling](https://www.wheelhouseit.com/structured-cabling): Professional structured cabling services including CAT5e/6/6A/7 and fiber optic network infrastructure optimization
- [Telecom Consulting](https://www.wheelhouseit.com/telecom-consulting): Telecom consulting and consolidation services including MPLS, SIP, hosted voice, and carrier selection

## Industry-Specific Solutions

- [Industry Solutions Directory](https://www.wheelhouseit.com/industries): Comprehensive industry-specific IT services with HIPAA and SEC compliance across multiple verticals
- [Healthcare IT Support](https://www.wheelhouseit.com/healthcare-it-support): Specialized healthcare IT support with HIPAA compliance, patient data security, and dedicated support teams
- [Accounting & Finance IT Services](https://www.wheelhouseit.com/it-services-for-accounting-firms-finance): Accounting firm IT services with 20+ years experience in compliance and cost consolidation
- [Manufacturing & Distribution IT](https://www.wheelhouseit.com/managed-it-services-for-manufacturing): Manufacturing and distribution IT services focused on downtime reduction, SOC 2 compliance, and 24/7 support
- [Insurance Agency IT Support](https://www.wheelhouseit.com/it-services-insurance): Insurance industry IT services with 20+ years experience in compliance and data security

## Service Locations

- [Fort Lauderdale](https://www.wheelhouseit.com/fort-lauderdale): Local managed and co-managed IT services for the Fort Lauderdale area
- [New York City](https://www.wheelhouseit.com/new-york-city): Full and co-managed IT services for the New York City metropolitan area
- [Orlando](https://www.wheelhouseit.com/orlando): Managed IT support services for the Orlando and Florida region
- [International IT Support](https://www.wheelhouseit.com/international-it-support): Global IT support and managed services with 50+ staff, 20+ years experience, and 24/7 helpdesk coverage
